groups.title: Simulate SRTF and derive waiting or turnaround time
groups.subject: 08-operating-systems
groups.rationale: Each question supplies process arrival times and one CPU burst per process, requires simulating preemptive shortest remaining time first (called SRPT in 2004), and derives an average from process completion times. They share the scheduling procedure, not identical statements or answers: 2004 and 2025 ask average turnaround with different inputs and preemption sequences; 2024 asks average waiting and additionally compares a nonpreemptive SJF schedule. Keep every variant accessible. Exclude conceptual scheduling properties, policy identification without an arrival/burst simulation, and CPU/I/O idle-time or utilization problems requiring alternating I/O phases. Sharing the CPU-scheduling topic alone is insufficient.
